RUNBOOK CORRECTIONS the next editor should apply (verified against 2.5.1 code, not defects): (1) C.anon.single-media claims /p/<media_id>/ is the canonical MVS URL - it is not. /p/([0-9]+) is BuddyNext's route (buddynext/includes/Core/PageRouter.php:2358, -> bn_hub=post), so /p/<mvs media id>/ correctly 404s. MVS's own route is /media/<slug>/ -> mvs_media_slug, and on this site BuddyNext redirects it via the documented mvs_single_media_redirect filter. The native MVS single page was verified by neutralising that filter for one request and returns 200 with h1, og:image, og:title, twitter:card, a 200 image/webp asset and 6 reaction buttons. (2) E.group-dm cites POST/GET /mvs-pro/v1/groups/{id}/messages - that route does not exist; group creation is /mvs-pro/v1/groups (a group IS a conversation) and messaging goes through Free's /mvs/v1/conversations/{id}/messages, which works end to end. A non-member gets 404, not the 403 the row states. (3) The Fixture cleanup block deletes mvs_reports WHERE reason LIKE 'smoke-%', but reason is an enum (spam|harassment|nudity|violence|copyright|misinformation|other) so that clause can never match - the free-text marker belongs in the details column. (4) C.member.video-poster-fallback names PosterService::is_ffmpeg_available() - PosterService has only dir(), stage_bytes() and stage_client_frame(), and no ffmpeg helper exists in Free at all. (5) D.documents-privacy-vocabulary asserts PRIVACY_VALUES is exactly private/members/public - it is now private/space/members/public, with space added for space drives. The bug the row guards is gone: nothing offers 'unlisted', and POST with unlisted or restricted both answer 400 mvs_document_privacy_invalid. (6) C.member.lightbox-edit-modal says the Edit cog appears ONLY on /my-media/ cards - in 2.5.1 an owner also sees it in the Explore lightbox for their own media. That is not a leak: for a non-owner the action computes display:none, and PUT and DELETE both answer 403 mvs_forbidden. The row's wording should be owner-scoped, not surface-scoped. (7) C.member.bulk-trash-restore-delete describes bulk Move to Trash plus a Trashed filter on /my-media/ - the member dashboard bulk bar offers only Set privacy, Add to album and Delete. Trash/Restore/Delete-permanently live on admin All Media, which is the surface this walk used.

UX gaps observed but not recorded as gate failures, for the maintainer's judgement: (a) admin Documents single view accepts a save with an empty title and reports 'Document updated.' while silently discarding the change - data is safe (the DB kept the previous title) but the feedback is wrong; (b) an admin All Media bulk submit with zero rows selected produces no notice at all - not destructive, but the runbook asks for a friendly error; (c) the lightbox edit modal exposes title, description, privacy and 'Update URL slug' but no allow_download control, although OPTIONS on /mvs/v1/media/{id} declares allow_download as editable; (d) POST /mvs/v1/media returns 201 after silently downgrading a requested privacy to the site default when mvs_allow_user_privacy is off, while PUT on the same resource returns mvs_privacy_locked - the create path should be as loud as the update path; (e) the collections picker's per-row 'Saving.../Saved' feedback could not be observed at 600ms or 3100ms after ticking, though the write landed and the Collections tab correctly showed '1 item' with a real cover thumbnail.
